text.tspan: From AOU_RX_CORE, one cycle per half flit
the covered granules, packed in arrival order
the residue, then the new granules,
cut into words of 8 granules (320 bits)
up to 7 granules of the partial word,
rewritten when later granules complete it
word and offset of the start,
5 banks of AOU_TPSRAM, 16 words of 320 bits each.
Consecutive words go to consecutive banks, so the
words written in one cycle, and the words of one
message, are each in different banks
the granules written since its start
reach its length, and the output
shift to the start offset, then extract by DLENGTH:
WDATA, WSTRB and FLEX (WriteDataFull: every strobe set),
or RDATA, RID, RRESP, RLAST and FLEX (data narrower
than 1024 bits is replicated across the bus)
